_comment: Single source of truth for the codex-acp patches: the approval-decoupling anchor (top-level keys) and the per-turn usage patch (`usage`) (D-008 amendment, 2026-07-31). Consumed by codex-acp-patch.ts (the runner image, via scripts/patch-codex-acp-approvals.ts) AND by services/runner/images/sandbox/daytona/build_snapshot.py (the Daytona snapshot image). Both surfaces MUST patch identically, or a Daytona run silently keeps cold approvals while a local run is warm. Keep the anchor here and nowhere else.

usage._comment: codex-acp reports a turn's PromptResponse.usage from tokenUsage.last, the LAST model call only, so a turn with tool calls is under-counted. These literal replacements make it report the turn's own share of the running tokenUsage.total instead: the baseline is taken at the turn's first update (total minus that call), which also holds for a resumed session. Applied by the same two surfaces as the approval patch.
